data.title: ONE Championship: Antonia Prifti wants Phetjeeja title shot rebooked after debut win
data.description: Greece’s Antonia Prifti wants her cancelled title shot against Phetjeeja Lukjaoporongtom rebooked after winning her ONE Championship debut.

data.title: Kanjutha's gold a landmark moment
data.description: Thailand struck gold in unfamiliar territory on Tuesday as Kanjutha Phattaraboonsorn choked back tears to deliver a landmark mixed martial arts triumph, headlining a golden day for the Thai contingent at the 20th Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026.

data.title: No fear from Thai footballers as they target Japan
data.description: Thailand’s men’s football team close out their Asian Games group campaign against the host nation tonight, chasing not just pride but top spot, and Auttapon Sangthong is promising that the side, unburdened by pressure, will go toe-to-toe with the tournament favourites.

data.title: Thai badminton star challenges doping ruling
data.description: Thailand’s rising badminton star Pitchamon Opatniputh has moved swiftly to challenge her positive drug test, requesting an analysis of her B sample after becoming the first confirmed doping case of the Asian Games in Japan.

data.title: India’s women retain Asian Games cricket crown
data.description: NAGOYA, Japan - India’s dominant women retained their Asian Games cricket crown in style on Tuesday as an Afghan cyclist who once disguised herself as a man won a “special” silver.

data.title: ONE Championship unveils AI-powered rankings after overhaul
data.description: ONE Championship has unveiled AI-powered rankings for four Muay Thai divisions, restoring an official pecking order after removing its previous lists at the end of 2025.

data.title: Thai teams ‘all aware’ of doping rules, minister says after positive test
data.description: NAGOYA - Tourism and Sports Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul ​said the nation's athletes at the Asian Games ​are all aware and ‌careful of doping rules following a failed drug test by one of the country's top badminton players.

data.title: Thailand says teams careful of doping rules after badminton player fails drug test
data.description: NAGOYA - Sports and Tourism Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul ​said the nation's athletes at the Asian Games ​are all aware and ‌careful of doping rules following a failed drug test by one of the country's top badminton players.

data.title: Afghan cyclist who disguised herself as man wins Asian Games silver
data.description: NAGOYA — An Afghan cyclist who disguised herself as a man to pursue her sporting dreams won an Asian Games silver medal on Tuesday, hoping it inspires other women in a country where Taliban authorities have sharply curtailed their freedoms.

data.title: ONE Championship: Freddie Haggerty targets Sam-A as he plots strawweight title route
data.description: Freddie Haggerty has set his sights on Thailand’s Sam-A Gaiyanghadao as he plots a route towards ONE Championship’s strawweight Muay Thai title – and says friendship would not stop him facing fellow Englishman Ellis Barboza.

data.title: Star coaches make their bows as Nations League returns
data.description: PARIS - The 2026/27 Nations League kicks off on Thursday but all eyes will be on the touchlines as a starry cast of new coaches, including Zinedine Zidane and Jurgen Klopp, prepare to make their debuts in international football.

data.title: Zidane gets down to work as France start new era
data.description: PARIS — Zinedine Zidane spent years patiently waiting in the wings for his chance to manage France and on Friday the successor to Didier Deschamps as coach of Les Bleus will lead the side out for the first time in a Uefa Nations League tie in Turkey.

data.title: Horses pass inspection, eventers ready
data.description: Thailand's national eventing team are ready to begin their campaign at the 20th Asian Games after all four horses successfully passed the official horse inspection on Sunday.

data.title: Asean Cup: Stars report for training
data.description: Thailand's national team have reported for a training camp ahead of the Fifa Asean Cup 2026 in Indonesia, with head coach Anthony Hudson bringing together a squad built around senior figures.

data.title: Buriram go top as own goal sinks Sharks
data.description: Buriram United moved to the top of the Thai League 1 table on Sunday night, edging out hosts Chonburi 1-0 in a tense encounter at Chonburi Stadium.

data.title: Infantino proposes consulting federations to reform FIFA
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - FIFA president Gianni Infantino on Monday suggested a "consultation" with the member federations to reform the world football governing body's decision-making processes, in a letter addressed to the 211 member associations, and seen by AFP.

data.title: Schoolgirl Yu scorches to second gold as doping case rocks Asian Games
data.description: NAGOYA (JAPAN) - Schoolgirl swimmer Yu Zidi won her second gold of the Asian Games on Monday with the fastest time in the world this year, while a teenage badminton player became the first doping case.

data.title: Doping shock rocks Thailand camp at Asian Games
data.description: Badminton player Pitchamon Opatniputh has emerged as the first known doping case at the 20th Asian Games in Japan, after the 19-year-old rising star returned a positive test that has rocked Thailand's campaign in Aichi-Nagoya.

data.title: ONE Championship: Jonathan Haggerty welcomes Rodtang trilogy and Superlek rematch – ‘I’m ready for it all’
data.description: Jonathan Haggerty has opened the door to a trilogy fight with Rodtang Jitmuangnon and another meeting with Superlek Kiatmoo9 – the two rivals responsible for his only defeats in ONE Championship.

data.title: China's Yu, 13, great for swimming says multiple Olympic medallist
data.description: TOKYO - China's 13-year-old sensation Yu Zidi is "exciting for the swimming world" and part of the sport's trend towards younger athletes, Hong Kong's multiple Olympic medallist Siobhan Haughey said on Monday.

data.title: Man City outgun Sunderland despite Brobbey hat-trick, Man Utd rescue Fulham draw
data.description: MANCHESTER - Manchester City went top of the Premier League despite Brian Brobbey's hat-trick in a 5-3 thriller on Sunday as Matheus Cunha rescued Manchester United from another damaging defeat at Fulham.

data.title: Ice-cool Pavit does it after 7 long years
data.description: Linkou: Pavit Tangkamolprasert holed a nerve-jangling four-foot birdie putt on the final hole to hold off defending champion Kazuki Higa and complete a memorable wire-to-wire victory at the Yeangder TPC yesterday.

data.title: PT Prachuap cruise to easy away victory over Pattani
data.description: PT Prachuap eased to a comfortable 3-0 victory over Pattani in the Thai League 1 at Tinsulanonda Stadium on Saturday night, with goals in each half securing all three points for the visitors.

data.title: PSG president Nasser al-Khelaifi under investigation in France for conflict of interest
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Nasser al-Khelaifi, the Qatari president of French football club Paris Saint-Germain (PSG), is under investigation in France on suspicion of an illegal conflict of interest, prosecutors in Paris said on Sunday.

data.title: Golden triple as Thais rule the table in Japan
data.description: Thailand’s teqball stars struck gold three times over in Nagoya on Sunday, sweeping the mixed, women’s and men’s doubles titles to announce themselves as the team to beat on the sport’s Asian Games debut.

data.title: Five-goal blitz secures Thailand's place in football quarters
data.description: Thailand put on a five-star show in Nagoya on Sunday, thrashing Hong Kong 5-1 to sail into the quarter-finals of the men's football event at the 20th Asian Games, with a second-half goal blitz putting the tie beyond doubt.

data.title: Former ⁠England ⁠forward Townsend hit by pitch roller while warming up in Thai league
data.description: Former ⁠England ⁠forward Andros Townsend ​was nearly run over by ​a motorised ‌pitch roller while warming up with his Prachuap teammates at half-time during a Thai League 1 match on ​Saturday.
